title: Reconstructing dark energy with fewer assumptions
efc_relevance: Bin-free ρ_DE(z) reconstruction with DESI + SDSS + Pantheon+ + Union3.1 + DES-Dovekie finds ρ_DE rising to a local maximum then decreasing, with two phantom-crossing oscillations near z ≈ 0.6–0.8. Directly comparable to EFC's predicted w(z) shape across the L2→L3 transition; supplies a model-independent target curve for the WP1 recovery-conditions table.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as bin-free w(z)-shape probe; update cluster desi_dr2_de_evolution; cross-reference arXiv:2606.05723, arXiv:2503.14738 and DOI:10.1038/s41550-025-02669-6; required EFC w(z) overlay on their reconstructed ρ_DE(z).
